must_keep.quote: 8.2. Deviations from Travel Plans paid by Third Parties: if passenger is travelling or has already scheduled travel plans for non-GS/OAS official travel, payment for the portion related to GS/OAS Official travel should only cover any additional expenses paid to deviate from the original travel plans. In no case, the GS/OAS portion should exceed the cost(s) of what the GS/OAS would pay if the initial travel plans did not exist.
must_keep.why: when travel is already paid by a third party, the GS/OAS covers only the added cost of deviating

must_keep.quote: All requests for GS/OAS Official Travel must be authorized in advance and in writing by the corresponding area's highest authority (Director or Secretary, the Chief of Staff or the Secretary General)

design_notes: Section 8.2 (lines 602-606): when the traveller already has travel plans paid by a third party, the GS/OAS pays only 'additional expenses paid to deviate from the original travel plans'. The IDB ticket already takes him to Santiago and home around the March 5 workshop, so there is nothing for the GS/OAS to buy. The Director's authorization is on file but unused (rule 4(b)).
